mapper.sql: tatr.id AS id, tatr.create_user_id AS createUserId, tatr.create_user_name AS createUserName, tatr.create_time AS createTime, tatr.update_user_id AS updateUserId, tatr.update_user_name AS updateUserName, tatr.update_time AS updateTime, tatr.version AS version, tatr.is_deleted AS isDeleted, tatr.code AS code, tatr.sys_module AS sysModule, tatr.business_type AS businessType, tatr.start_time AS startTime, tatr.end_time AS endTime, tatr.exec_timeout AS execTimeout, tatr.retry_times AS retryTimes, tatr.is_retry AS isRetry, tatr.status AS status, tatr.data_json AS dataJson, tatr.error_data AS errorData, tatr.detail_count AS detailCount, tatr.error_count AS errorCount, tatr.exec_type AS execType, tatr.method_type AS methodType
mapper.select: SELECT tatr.id AS id, tatd.id AS detailId, tatd.business_id AS businessId, tatd.business_code AS businessCode, tatd.error_data AS errorData FROM tms_async_task_record as tatr left join tms_async_task_detail as tatd on tatd.main_id = tatr.id and tatd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE tatr.is_deleted = FALSE and tatd.status ='failed' and tatr.id = #{id} ORDER BY tatd.create_time desc
